name: Node.js 18
author: nellow@localhost
description: Node.js egg dengan custom startup file, custom startup command, dan auto npm install.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ ! -z "${NODE_PACKAGES}" ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}; fi; if [[ ! -z "${UNNODE_PACKAGES}" ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm uninstall ${UNNODE_PACKAGES}; fi; if [[ "{{AUTO_INSTALL}}" == "1" ]] && [[ -f /home/container/package.json ]]; then /usr/local/bin/npm install ${NPM_ARGS}; fi; {{CUSTOM_STARTUP}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Node.js installer
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 libtool

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [[ ! -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]]; then
    if [[ "${GIT_ADDRESS}" != *.git ]]; then GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"; fi
    if [[ ! -z "${USERNAME}" ]] && [[ ! -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]]; then
        GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
    fi
    if [[ -z "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]]; then
        if [[ ! -z "${BRANCH}" ]]; then
            git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
        else
            git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
        fi
    fi
fi

if [[ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]]; then
    /usr/local/bin/npm install --production
fi

echo "Install selesai"
exit 0

variables.name: Startup File
variables.description: File utama yang dijalankan (relatif terhadap root server).

variables.name: Custom Startup Command
variables.description: Perintah start terakhir. Boleh diganti, contoh: node ${STARTUP_FILE} atau npm start. Variabel lain bisa dipakai dengan ${NAMA}.

variables.name: Auto Install
variables.description: 1 = jalankan npm install otomatis kalau ada package.json sebelum start.

variables.name: NPM Install Arguments
variables.description: Argumen tambahan untuk npm install, contoh: --omit=dev

variables.name: Extra Packages
variables.description: Paket npm tambahan yang di-install saat start (pisah spasi).

variables.name: Uninstall Packages
variables.description: Paket npm yang di-uninstall saat start (pisah spasi).

variables.name: Git Auto Update
variables.description: 1 = git pull otomatis saat start (hanya jika ada folder .git).
